text:
erin_g: FYI deploybot just finished a 0.5% canary of `quant-kernel-2026-07-q1` and checksum watchdog tripped on a small subset of nodes. routing rolled back but p95 still jittering.

viktor_m: checksum watchdog? which checksum and what's failing?

erin_g: bundle signature mismatch on model shard A after unpack on g2-us-09. message: "checksum mismatch: expected abc123, saw abd124". deploybot forced a revert but a few requests hit a different codepath and saw p95 +25%.

leah_c: is this a packaging or unpack bug? packaging pipeline changed compression level last week.

viktor_m: could also be a quant binary variant built with different symbol order. did CI artifacts vary?

erin_g: preliminary: artifact matches CI in storage, but when untarring on that host the md5 differs. suspect transient disk corruption or a bad unzip stream. we should pin and re-run bake on that host class.

release-coordinator: options: (1) pin canary back to previous bundle for that pool, (2) mark node g2-us-09 as quarantined and let rollout continue, (3) re-run artifact push with fresh signatures. fastest is to pin.

deploybot: available commands: `pin-version --target=us-west-canary --version=2026-06-quant-stable --ttl=2h` or `quarantine-node --node=g2-us-09 --reason="checksum mismatch"`.

viktor_m: quarantine the node and pin the canary pool. quarantine avoids rolling back healthy hosts. pin TTL 2h is fine.

erin_g: doing both: `quarantine-node g2-us-09` then `pin-version --target=us-west-canary --version=2026-06-quant-stable --ttl=2h --reason="checksum mismatch on g2-us-09"`

deploybot: executed: node g2-us-09 quarantined. pin applied to us-west-canary, TTL 2h. routing weight reverted.

opsbot: running artifact integrity sweep across us-west-night nodes: `ops verify-artifacts --pattern=quant-kernel-2026-07-q1 --nodes=us-west-*` ETA 5m.

opsbot: sweep results: 1 node (g2-us-09) shows corrupted tar stream; rest are clean. suggested action: reprovision g2-us-09 disk and rehydrate artifacts, then unquarantine and run a local unpack check. logs: https://internal.run/artifact-sweep/3099998888

leah_c: sounds like infra flake. i'll file a quick infra ticket and request re-provision. also adding a postmortem note to the release ticket about hardening unpack checks in the agent (verify checksum before switch).

release-coordinator: thank you. public release note line: "We paused a small canary for quant-kernel-2026-07-q1 after an integrity failure on a single host; no customer impact observed; team is re-provisioning the host and will re-run validation before continuing rollout." internal: add action items to add pre-unpack verification and make watchdog more descriptive.

erin_g: monitoring shows p95 settled near baseline after pin. leaving pin TTL 2h so infra can fix. opsbot will alert if any other nodes report checksum mismatch.

opsbot: subscribed. will escalate to @oncall if checksum mismatches >0 or p95 > baseline *1.2 for 10m."
